payload.rationale: This document is a new sprint retro that closely echoes the prior Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322 — same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity, same Zephyr integration as key unlock. I expanded the prior retro document and all positions/observations directly sourced from it (ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, TinaVelocity, Sprint4ThesisProven, TanyaThesisProven, MetricAnchor style obs) so the passes can detect whether this is a duplicate or an update. I also expanded the two core narratives this retro bears on — AntiSlackPositioning and DecisionCaptureAtConsensus — plus their child positions (CoreFeatureDecisionCapture, ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, AntiPatternRealtimeChat) because the retro's 'shipped the async decision widget' language directly extends the thesis-proven frame. ContextPreservationNextSprint was included because a new retro may update the next-sprint focus. PricingTwelveDollars was included since the prior retro recorded a pricing update and this retro's velocity claims may touch the same packaging thread. I did not expand Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams or Position_WebhookArchitecture as the document makes no reference to target market or architecture decisions.
